decisions.reason: The source relies on the already-established reuse of existing content but does not change which materials are reused or their reuse purpose.
SEO-preservation and migration planning do not change the competitor-inspired layout, structure, navigation, or reference website.
The source addresses migration and SEO protection without changing the Shatter House brand name or Ridgehaven brand identity.
The conditional possibility of retaining and linking the Harbor Valley site does not change the established master domain mapping for shatterhouse.example.
The conditional statement about linking the legacy Harbor Valley website does not necessarily alter the master site's established location-discovery and sublink behavior.
The SEO migration plan does not change support for future franchise locations or the consistent location-template strategy.
SEO preservation and legacy-site migration do not change the requirement for each location to track revenue and sales separately.
SEO preservation and migration planning do not change the requirement for each location to manage its bookings separately.
